General Information for the Posts Mentioned Above
1. Walk-in Interview will be conducted on 26th November 2026
2. Venue: Office of the District Medical & Health Officer (DM&HO), South Garo Hills Baghmara
3. Time of the interview: 11:00 AM · '
4. Registration time: 9:00AM to 10:00 AM .No applications will be entertained after 10:00 AM.
5. Candidates shall bring the necessary ORIGINAL Certificates,documents, etc on the day of the interview.
General Instruction:
I. All ~andid~es must submit ~eir appli~ations in presc:ibe stand~d form along with self attested photocopies of the
certificates m support of thetr educational qualtficattons, expenence, date of birth, ST Certificates and 1 recent
passport size photo etc during the registration. A candidate will have to produce caste certificate/ relevant certificates
at the time of personal interview in original, failing which his/her candidature will be cancelled.
2. Before applying for the post, the candidate should ensure that he/she fulfils the eligibility criteria mentioned in this
advertisement. Decision of the organisation in all matters regarding eligibility of the candidate, the documents to be
produced and any other matter relating to -recruitment will be final and binding. No correspondence or personal
enquiries shall be entertained.
3. Incomplete Application will be summarily rejected without any consent of the applicant, therefore read the
instruction carefully before applying.
4. No TA/DA will be provided for the candidates for appearing in the Interview.
